decks.name: LeetCode #739 - Daily Temperatures
decks.description: Find how many days until a warmer temperature for each day

cards.question: Daily Temperatures: Given an array of integers temperatures representing daily temperatures, return an array answer where answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after the i-th day to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future day for which this is possible, keep answer[i] equal to 0 instead.

solutions.name: Stack
solutions.explanation: Use a monotonic decreasing stack to store indices of temperatures. For each temperature, pop indices from the stack while current temperature is warmer, and for each popped index, calculate the number of days by subtracting indices. This efficiently finds the next warmer day in a single pass.

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time where n is the number of temperatures. Each index is pushed and popped from the stack at most once.
solutions.spaceDescription: Linear space for the stack and output array. In the worst case (decreasing temperatures), the stack contains all indices.
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: For temperatures=[73,74,75,71,69,72,76,73]: Start with empty stack. At index 0 (73), push 0. At index 1 (74>73), pop 0, set res[0]=1-0=1, push 1. At index 2 (75>74), pop 1, set res[1]=2-1=1, push 2. Continue pattern. Result: [1,1,4,2,1,1,0,0].

solutions.name: Dynamic Programming
solutions.explanation: Build the answer array from right to left. For each day, use previously computed results to skip ahead efficiently. If the next day is warmer, we're done. Otherwise, jump ahead by the number of days stored in the result for that next day. This optimization allows us to avoid checking every day individually.

Set j to n
Break out of loop
Increment j by res at index j

Calculate j minus i and store in res at index i

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time where n is the number of temperatures. Although nested loops appear, each day is visited a constant amortized number of times due to the jumping optimization.
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant extra space beyond the output array. The algorithm only uses a few variables for indices.
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: For temperatures=[73,74,75,71,69,72,76,73]: Start from index 6 (76), res[6]=0. At index 5 (72), next day 76>72, set res[5]=1. At index 4 (69), next day 72>69, set res[4]=1. At index 3 (71), next day 69<=71, jump by res[4]=1 to day 5 (72>71), set res[3]=2. Continue backwards.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: For each day, scan forward through all subsequent days until finding a warmer temperature. Count the number of days until a warmer day is found. If no warmer day exists, set count to zero. Simple but inefficient approach with nested loops.
